# Solas 1.1.0
## ✨ What's new
- A new welcome experience introduces your pond, ripples, fish feeding, and essential settings, with an option to activate a license or enjoy the free trial. Revisit it anytime from the menu. - Jade Depths brings a shaded slate-and-teal riverbed and soft sunlight to your pond. - Follow Device Time now offers a custom daily schedule. Choose when each weather begins, or keep Auto for the familiar day-to-night cycle. - Weather choices are easier to browse, grouped into Time of Day, Water & Depth, and Rain & Storm. - Refreshed daylight, sunset, and nighttime lighting gives each time of day a more distinct atmosphere. - Refined water currents have softer broad bands and clearer fine detail that gently fades toward the pond’s center. Highlights complement your water color and the weather’s light. - Reset All Settings in General restores your preferences to their defaults while keeping your license and trial.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Clarity now follows your slider setting consistently across all weather presets. - Current Strength now works across its full range, including values above 100%. - Settings opens on your current desktop. Closing the last Solas window removes its Dock icon while the pond keeps running.

# Solas 1.0.3
## ✨ What's new
- The pond now stays visible as a still wallpaper when your trial ends. Activate a license to resume animation. - Koi are spaced apart in the still wallpaper shown after the trial ends.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Fixed app updates failing with "An error occurred while launching the installer." - Fixed the wallpaper failing to appear or appearing late when launching with other apps open or switching desktops. - Fixed enabled plants, including lily pads, missing from paused ponds. - Fixed small fish disappearing when many koi were enabled.

# Solas 1.0.2
## ✨ What's new
- Refreshed app icon.
